cross_node_timing_qualifications: Each method retains its own co-located target-only control. Hardware, drivers, allocation priority and preemption histories remain separate per input run.

Raw throughput and cross-method timing rankings across nodes can reflect hardware or system differences. AR-normalized speedups remain within-method comparisons; no same-hardware cross-method ranking is established.

This collection reproduces configured numerical cells and observed T=0 comparisons only. Temperature-one distributional correctness and losslessness remain unestablished; the scientific training gate remains closed.

effective_config.timing_scope: Synchronized generation including prefill and unused final drafting; excludes model load, tokenization, detokenization and disk logging
